plain_summary: The model tells good and bad outcomes apart correctly about 75% of the time, which meets the bar set for this use.
recommendation: Track AUC in production monitoring with an alert at the declared minimum.
summary: AUC 0.748 (95% CI 0.731-0.765) on 3660 held-out rows is above the declared minimum of 0.70. Accuracy 0.773, F1 0.859 at threshold 0.5. Training AUC is 0.951, 0.204 higher than on held-out data, which suggests overfitting.
title: Predictive performance
